title: CastomCommands
description: This data pack adds some special useful commands to Minecraft via /trigger
body:
## This data pack adds several useful commands using /trigger.
**These commands work, not only if cheats are enabled in the world. Any player with or without operator rights will be able to use these commands.      
List of commands and what they do:**

<details>
<summary>/trigger Block</summary>

Creates a solid block under players. Convenient to use for building something in the sky   
Example of work:<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/WVuafGttYiA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

</details>

<details>
<summary>/trigger Del</summary>
Removes all lying items
  
Example of work:<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/PjkPC6lMbvI" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


</details>


<details>
<summary>/trigger E_Resistance</summary>
Gives effects of eternal Resistance level 255, Essentially you are immortal
  
Example of work:<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/wrI8J0N2uwM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


</details>


<details>
<summary>/tregger E_Strength</summary>

Gives effects of eternal Strength level 255, you can choose any mob with one hit   
Example of work:<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/3DXucraOV_k" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

</details>


<details>
<summary>/tregger End</summary>

Creates a port to the end right inside you    
Example of work:<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/RcIB5gNhJnE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

</details>
